cs1.title: CS-1
cs1.description: A CS-80-style polysynth: two layers, its tone bars, effects and user presets, with velocity and aftertouch from the keys.
cs1.alt: CS-1's screen: its tone bars and the preset BLADE BRASS

scintilla.title: Scintilla
scintilla.description: The 1981 Elka Synthex with all 80 factory patches, the laser harp among them, checked sample by sample against its browser original.
scintilla.alt: Scintilla's screen: the patch RING MOD., the laser harp

obervave.title: OberVave
obervave.description: A four-track analog-style poly with arpeggiator, sequencer and effects; its pages, presets and patterns live in fm1-dock's banks.
obervave.alt: OberVave's PERFORM page: cutoff, resonance, envelope, release

fm1-sid.source: joakimeriksson/fm1-sid 3210dc1 (FM-1 SID 0.3's code), dock/build.sh with fm1-dock 3cd4e55
fm1-sid.songs: GoatTracker 2's example songs: Dojo, Unleash, Sanction, Consultant, Transylvanian, Hyperspace, Sixpack, Everlasting
fm1-sid.title: FM-1 SID
fm1-sid.description: C64 music: a cycle-exact 6510 and reSID, GoatTracker 2 songs with their editor on the knobs, and any .sid from its page plays at once.
fm1-sid.alt: FM-1 SID's screen: Arkanoid by Martin Galway, three voices, the filter, the scope

amb.source: modules/amb: charlesvestal/fm1-amb 7797f4e (AMB-1 1.3 and one commit), fm1-dock 2037c7b
amb.title: AMB-1
amb.description: A generative ambient machine after Music for Airports: pads, bells on tape loops and a gliding bass play themselves while you tend them.
amb.alt: AMB-1's screen: the Garden, D Dorian on Dm7, the four layers' levels

fomni.source: modules/fomni: charlesvestal/fm1-fomni 7e7547f (FoMni-1 0.4 and four commits), fm1-dock 2037c7b
fomni.title: FoMni
fomni.description: A chord harp after the Omnichord: chords on the black keys, strummed on the white ones, with a bass and a rhythm box.
fomni.alt: FoMni's screen: the chord C, the strings and the chord buttons

fm106.source: modules/fm106: PatttF/fm-106 db59d58 (FM-106 Beta 6 and one commit; modules/fm106/take.py), fm1-dock f3fdddb
fm106.title: FM-106
fm106.description: The Roland Juno-106: six voices, the 128 factory presets, its BBD chorus, arpeggiator and sequencer; three voices run on the chip's second core.
fm106.alt: FM-106's screen: the preset A85 Rocket Men, three voices playing, the VCF's sliders and the oscilloscope

monk.source: modules/monk: charlesvestal/fm1-monk a9d368a (MONK-1 0.9.1 and four commits; modules/monk/take.py), fm1-dock 5c44a92
monk.title: MONK-1
monk.description: Twelve singers on MonkSynth's formant voice, each on its own stage: the mouth follows the vowel, and the keys give velocity and pressure.
monk.alt: MONK-1's screen: Jerry the monk singing with his mouth wide open, Vowel, Head, Breath and Glide below

fimba.title: FiMba-1
fimba.description: A kalimba by modal synthesis: tines on the white keys, thumb-roll chords on the black, with its body, buzzers, a sound hole's wah, delay and reverb.
fimba.alt: FiMba-1's screen: three tines ringing in C major, the chord keys, Material Steel, Hardness, Decay and Tone

gator.title: GATOR
gator.description: A macro-oscillator on Emilie Gillet's Plaits DSP: 24 models in 3 banks, a low-pass gate, two LFOs and an 8-slot modulation matrix.
gator.alt: GATOR's screen: the model WAVETABLE, its harmonics, timbre and morph, the wave under them

dub.source: modules/dub: sbegueria/fm1-dub 501c4cf (DUB-1 1.4.3 and five commits; modules/dub/take.py), fm1-dock 9d3aac5
dub.title: DUB-1
dub.voices: 4 chord voices, 6 pings, a bass, 5 drums
dub.description: A generative dub techno machine, AMB-1's fork: chord stabs dissolve in a tape echo over a steady kick, in eight pieces it plays by itself.
dub.alt: DUB-1's screen: the Form page, the chord Fm7 in its ripples, the lanes of the phrase, Energy, Vary, Motion and Drift

prophet.source: modules/prophet: keremimo/melodee e9b07b4 (branch next; modules/prophet/take.py), fm1-dock
prophet.title: PROPHET
prophet.description: A Prophet-5 Rev 4 on Melodee's engine: Poly-Mod, two filter characters, glide, unison and Vintage; INIT and eight patches of its own, and your own bank if you send one.
prophet.alt: PROPHET's screen: the patch STRINGS, 3 of 8, its MAIN page with cutoff, resonance, envelope amount and release

fm6.title: FM6
fm6.voices: 16, half on the second core (10 on one core)
fm6.description: A DX7-style six-operator FM synth on Melodee's engine: 32 algorithms, feedback, DX7 envelopes and scaling, three renderers; its own 24 voices, and your own DX7 SysEx voices if you send them.
fm6.alt: FM6's screen: the voice TINE EP, 1 of 24, its MAIN page with algorithm, feedback, brightness and mod envelope

b3.title: B3 ORGAN
b3.license: GPL-3.0-only (its organ model after setBfree, GPL-2.0-or-later)
b3.description: A tonewheel organ modelled on setBfree: nine drawbars, key click, vibrato and chorus, percussion, overdrive, reverb and a Leslie; setBfree's 110 programs and its MIDI controllers.
b3.alt: B3 ORGAN's screen: the nine drawbars of Standard B (88 8000 000), vibrato, Leslie, percussion, overdrive and reverb under them

niagara.title: Niagara Drift
niagara.description: A drone synth after the Lyra-8, the Subharmonicon and the DS-2: two drones that breathe and drift, scenes you press into, gestures, a delay and a reverb. Its delay reaches 270 ms here (450 in the original).
niagara.alt: Niagara Drift's screen: PLAY 1, SWELL, the two drones' waves, their pitch and cutoff

artihive.title: ARTIHIVE
artihive.description: An experimental drone and polyphonic synth: eight voices as four interacting FM pairs, DRONE and POLY modes, a Hyper LFO, stereo motion, a modulated two-line delay (1 s here), distortion, compression, mutation and an arpeggiator.
artihive.alt: ARTIHIVE's screen: DRONE, voice 1, the output's wave, four envelopes, TUNE, FINE, SHARP and MOD, the eight voices' tunings

fmini.source: modules/fmini: ruppert/fmini-1 7619d90 (FMini-1 2.2.0: its FMINI engine, factory patches and effects) and hugelton/Felucca-Engines c46e008 (dsp.c; modules/fmini/take.py), fm1-dock
fmini.title: FMINI-1
fmini.voices: 1 (MONO, LEGATO) or 12 (POLY, half on the second core; 8 on one core)
fmini.description: FMini-1's monosynth in the style of the classic three-oscillator Moogs: three oscillators and noise, the mixer's soft overload, the 24 dB ladder with its own contour, its 200 factory patches and FMini-1's own effects (drive, chorus, delay, reverb). FMini-1's engine, patches and effects with fm1-dock's own interface and arpeggiator: its sequencer is not in the module.
fmini.alt: FMINI-1's screen: the patch PAD SWELL, F004 of 200, its FILTER page with cutoff, emphasis, contour and keyboard control

atek303.title: ATEK303
atek303.description: A TB-303 style acid machine with its own pattern generator: press PLAY and a line plays. Generate, mutate and edit up to 64 steps, 14 oscillators, drive, chorus, a synced delay and a plate reverb, 12 factory presets in 32 slots.
atek303.alt: ATEK303's screen: the preset COSMIC TRAX playing, cutoff, resonance, env mod and decay, the 16 steps under them

keys.title: KEYS
keys.voices: 24, half on the second core (16 on one core)
keys.description: A clavinet, an electric piano and a piano from physical models: a plucked string after Mutable Instruments' Plaits (Emilie Gillet) with two pickups and a wah, a struck tine into a magnetic pickup that barks when hit hard, two stiff strings over a soundboard; ten presets, the keys' velocity in all three.
keys.alt: KEYS' screen: the preset EP BARK, E.PIANO 2 of 3, the three families, Tone, Decay, Pickup and Volume

sine.title: SINE
sine.description: Dinghy's sine, always there: the fallback when a module fails, and the smallest module to copy when you write your own.
sine.alt: SINE's screen: a sine to build on, the note C4
